name: @pipeworx/mcp-skyvern

tools.name: skyvern_run_task
tools.description: Start a Skyvern browser-agent run against a website that publishes no API (search forms, logins, multi-step lookups), described in plain language, and wait briefly for it. Returns the extracted output if the run finishes within wait_seconds (default 20); otherwise returns finished false and a run_id to continue with skyvern_get_run. Runs take seconds to minutes and are billed to your Skyvern account per step. Requires your own Skyvern API key as _apiKey.

prompt.description: What the agent should do and return, e.g. "Search for Wikimedia Foundation and return its EIN".

url.description: Starting page, e.g. the search form. Omit to let Skyvern choose.

data_extraction_schema.description: Optional JSON Schema for the output; strongly recommended so the result is structured.

max_steps.description: Cap on browser steps (billed per step). Default 25.

wait_seconds.description: How long to wait for the result before returning the run_id (0 to 20, default 20). 0 starts the run and returns immediately.

_apiKey.description: Your Skyvern API key (from your Skyvern account settings). Every run is billed to your Skyvern account.

tools.name: skyvern_get_run
tools.description: Get the status and output of a Skyvern run by run_id, optionally waiting up to wait_seconds for it to finish. Final statuses are completed, failed, terminated, timed_out and canceled; anything else means keep polling. Requires your own Skyvern API key as _apiKey.

wait_seconds.description: Wait up to this long for a final status (0 to 20, default 0).

_apiKey.description: Your Skyvern API key (from your Skyvern account settings). Every run is billed to your Skyvern account.

tools.name: skyvern_cancel_run
tools.description: Cancel a Skyvern run that is still queued or running, to stop further per-step billing. Requires your own Skyvern API key as _apiKey.

_apiKey.description: Your Skyvern API key (from your Skyvern account settings). Every run is billed to your Skyvern account.

instructions: @pipeworx/mcp-skyvern forwards to the Pipeworx gateway and lists only the skyvern pack's tools. Set PIPEWORX_META_TOOLS=1 to also list ask_pipeworx and the other gateway-wide tools.
